answer: One concrete defense is bonded proof-of-work staking: each agent must lock a sable-marked deposit and periodically solve a puzzle broadcast by a public beacon. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand real bonds and a thousand puzzle solutions, so a Sybil swarm bleeds capital instead of discovering a cost-free oasis. Honest agents reclaim their bond; detected clones forfeit it, making mass forgery economically irrational.
